description: This file defines the InterviewDecorator class in the OrangeHRM project, providing helper methods to manage interview entities, including setting candidates, interviewers, and retrieving formatted interview dates and times.

classes.name: InterviewDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing additional functionalities for the Interview entity, such as setting related entities and formatting interview date/time.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an Interview entity.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancyById
methods.description: Sets the CandidateVacancy relation on the interview by ID.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Sets the Candidate relation on the interview by ID.

methods.name: setInterviewerByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Adds multiple Employee interviewers to the interview based on their employee numbers.

methods.name: addInterviewer
methods.description: Adds a single Employee as an interviewer if not already present.

methods.name: removeInterviewers
methods.description: Removes all interviewers from the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewDate
methods.description: Returns the interview date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getInterviewTime
methods.description: Returns the interview time formatted as a string, or null if not set.
